states.changed: The work is built: 51 signals of eleven public instruments on one clock, by who reads each first and whether it says who acted, with this house's own clock beside them.

The page now shows which of the 51 signals has left a public trace (9 of the 42 due, none on a public body's own site), dates on two time lines the cases where machines acted on their own, from the first act to the public bodies' word, and marks on each of the house's 52 deeds when one revert could no longer undo it.
